artifacts: Raw logs, traces, checkpoints, streams and observation tensors stay ignored under runs/api. After execution publish compact metrics/provenance and actual-training GIFs only. Keep technique-inventory.md as the sole generated goal leaderboard.

gates.retention: Not authorized by this protocol; separate passing smoke checkpoint dependency and predeclared tier2 budget required.
gates.smoke: Any scheduled full passing state plus one independent same-state confirmation satisfying every unchanged bound; both arms still finish1600updates.
gates.sustained_diagnostic: Also report unchanged five-terminal-full-pass reducer and longest passing streak; neither replaces smoke or confers ordinary qualification.

held_fixed: one protocol seed0; no seed sweep
uniform16-component 2D Gaussian target, ring radius3, sigma0.1
learned uniform256-row MoG prior, sigma0.1, standardizeFalse
BCAP penalty and normalized biases/sampled prior rows
constant G/D/prior rates and optimizer momentum0
recipe horizon400 and full1600 update cap
clean live serving through public prior without output noise or EMA

restored.role: original restart reproduction; distinct runtime path, not a fresh continuous candidate control

inherited_software_evidence.scope: unchanged typed extension/trainer checkpoint binding; scientific run asserts serialized mode at every polar call

initializer: public deterministic orthogonal named initializer; public R2 table for prior
metric_backend: Frozen scorer on saved CUDA-generated sample tensors copied to CPU; no CPU model forward/backward or SVD. Keeps prior metric cohort unchanged.

predictions.combined: Confirmation and terminal quality support compatibility of both interventions; report failures after first pass and compare acquisition timing without a speed ranking.
predictions.falsifier: Failure of confirmation or terminal gates is negative for this exact combination/recipe/budget. Even a positive diagnostic needs full Tier1 before adoption.

reused_runner.changes: Admit one combined arm with full reservation; invoke both existing execution and polar hooks. Shared public training/scoring loop unchanged.

rng_contract.confirmation: one separate named evaluation confirmation stream, drawn only at first scheduled full passing state;4096 samples before any further update
rng_contract.data_and_prior: existing separate named training streams; checkpoint every consumed stream
rng_contract.matching: Compare initial model/prior tensors and full target batch digest across actual arms and prior interventions; checkpoint all named streams and initial/401/final ambient CPU/CUDA states.
rng_contract.training_noise: no new training-noise consumption; unused helper stream retained only for shared harness identity

schedule_contract.comparisons: Reuse completed continuous truncation and continuous serialization under their original source, with exact initial tensors/recipe/prior/target batches/cadence/gates checks.
schedule_contract.every_step: Fresh public initialization; all1600 updates serialized and all G/D polar directions truncated. No restart or checkpoint loading.

stopping_rules: Freeze source/protocol before paid work; every attempt counts, no retries or repeat of consumed arms.
Finish the combined arm to1600 even if a smoke state passes.
Stop an arm on nonfinite training, source/stream mismatch, timeout or budget exhaustion; retain raw error and actual cost.
No seed changes, periodic restart, annealing, prior refresh, subbatch repeat, architecture change, threshold grid or relaxed covariance bound.
Do not spend automatically on retention or import these diagnostic results into ordinary qualification.
Reject non-CUDA models; assert ordinary caller autograd mode before and after every update. All GPU jobs sequential on physicalGPU0.

trainer_delta.matrix_update: Unmodified measured PR332 U diag(s > max(matrix.shape)*float32_epsilon*smax) Vh rule
trainer_delta.serial_backward: Public GANTrainer.serial_backward=True from initialization, typed opt-in extension; caller mode restored each step

user_authorization: User asked should we try with both; accepted combined quality run on2026-10-07. Prior request excludes empirical speed testing.
